Description: GuardDuty detectors do not have Lambda Protection enabled to identify potential security threats on AWS Lambda function invocation.
Risk: Without this setting Lambda network activity logs are not analyzed and potential security issues that affect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of data may go unnoticed.

Recommendation.Text: Consider enabling GuardDuty Lambda Protection for all detectors across accounts and regions, along with applying the principle of least privilege on Lambda functions and roles, or accessing scanning results.
